blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate Committee on Ethics and Privileges has reiterated its request to Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa to submit his written response, along with any information relevant to the ethics complaint filed against him by civil society group Wag Kang KuCorrupt over his prolonged absences. In a Nov. 20 letter, Sen. Vicente Sotto III, the committee chair, told Dela Rosa that no documents had been submitted apart from those already transmitted to him. “Please be informed that no other submission has been made in relation to the complaint,” Sotto said.
